title: Jack Dorsey launches Buzz to combine team chat, AI agents and Git hosting
summary: Jack Dorsey, through Block (formerly Square), has launched a new platform called Buzz that unifies team chat, AI agents, and Git hosting into a single collaborative environment for developers and technical teams.
problem_solved: Addresses tool fragmentation by combining communication, AI assistance, and code versioning into one unified workspace for development teams.
why_valuable: Reduces context-switching overhead for developers by integrating essential tools (chat, git, AI) into a single platform, potentially improving team productivity and collaboration.
